texto: {"findings":[{"tipo":"GPU","causa_raiz":"O tempo de renderizacao na GPU atingiu 30.19ms contra o teto de 16.7ms (violacoes acumuladas: 514 frames), indicando sobrecarga massiva no fill rate, shaders excessivamente complexos ou custo elevado de efeitos de pos-processamento em resolucao nativa para a GTX 1650.","codigo_refatorado":"using UnityEngine;\\nusing UnityEngine.Rendering;\\n\\npublic class PerformanceScaler : MonoBehaviour\\n{\\n    [SerializeField] private float targetFrameRate = 60.0f;\\n    [SerializeField] private float minResolutionScale = 0.70f;\\n    [SerializeField] private float maxResolutionScale = 1.0f;\\n    private float currentScale = 1.0f;\\n\\n    void Awake()\\n    {\\n        Application.targetFrameRate = 60;\\n        QualitySettings.vSyncCount = 0;\\n    }\\n\\n    void Update()\\n    {\\n        float currentFps = 1.0f / Mathf.Max(Time.unscaledDeltaTime, 0.0001f);\\n        if (currentFps < targetFrameRate - 5f && currentScale > minResolutionScale)\\n        {\\n            currentScale = Mathf.Max(minResolutionScale, currentScale - 0.05f * Time.unscaledDeltaTime);\\n            ScalableBufferManager.ResizeBuffers(currentScale, currentScale);\\n        }\\n        else if (currentFps >= targetFrameRate && currentScale < maxResolutionScale)\\n        {\\n            currentScale = Mathf.Min(maxResolutionScale, currentScale + 0.02f * Time.unscaledDeltaTime);\\n            ScalableBufferManager.ResizeBuffers(currentScale, currentScale);\\n        }\\n    }\\n}","explicacao_didatica":"A placa de video esta demorando quase o dobro do tempo permitido para pintar os pixels da tela. Para resolver isso, usamos uma resolucao dinamica que reduz suavemente a quantidade de pixels desenhados quando o jogo fica pesado, aliviando a placa de video sem que o jogador perceba quedas bruscas de frames."},{"tipo":"GC","causa_raiz":"Picos de Garbage Collector pausando o loop principal (5.61ms de coleta com alocacoes de ate 98KB por frame), gerando microtravamentos causados por instanciacao dinamica repetitiva ou criacao de objetos descartaveis na memoria.","codigo_refatorado":"using System.Collections.Generic;\\nusing UnityEngine;\\n\\npublic class SimpleObjectPool : MonoBehaviour\\n{\\n    public static SimpleObjectPool Instance { get; private set; }\\n    [SerializeField] private GameObject prefab;\\n    [SerializeField] private int initialSize = 50;\\n    private readonly Queue<GameObject> pool = new Queue<GameObject>();\\n\\n    void Awake()\\n    {\\n        Instance = this;\\n        for (int i = 0; i < initialSize; i++)\\n        {\\n            GameObject obj = Instantiate(prefab, transform);\\n            obj.SetActive(false);\\n            pool.Enqueue(obj);\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    public GameObject Get()\\n    {\\n        GameObject obj = pool.Count > 0 ? pool.Dequeue() : Instantiate(prefab, transform);\\n        obj.SetActive(true);\\n        return obj;\\n    }\\n\\n    public void ReturnToPool(GameObject obj)\\n    {\\n        obj.SetActive(false);\\n        pool.Enqueue(obj);\\n    }\\n}","explicacao_didatica":"Quando voce cria e destroi objetos constantemente com Instantiate e Destroy, a memoria fica cheia de lixo e a Unity pausa o jogo para limpar (Garbage Collection). O Pooling reutiliza objetos desativando-os em vez de destrui-los, eliminando essas travadinhas."}],"dicas_level_design":null}
